org_config.description: org baseline contract ref owner/repo[/path][@ref] — org floor per spec/org-policy.md; empty = repo contract + defaults

runtime_ref.description: ref of os-santiago/ai-sdlc to fetch runtime scripts (intake-refiner.js, dup-detector.js, epic-decomposer.js) from — pin to the same ref as this workflow

trigger_label.description: label that arms dispatch — override; empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml triggers.issue_label

dispatch.description: "true" when the issue passes DoR and is queued

ledger_head.description: sealed run-ledger chain head — pass to the next stage as ledger_head (issue #196)

AI_SDLC_APP_ID.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App id — mints a per-run installation token for labels/comments; optional (falls back to AI_SDLC_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN, issue #26)

AI_SDLC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App private key (PEM) — pairs with AI_SDLC_APP_ID

AI_SDLC_LEDGER_KEY.description: run-ledger signing key (PEM; Ed25519/RSA) — seals stage evidence; absent = unsigned seal (issue #196)

AI_SDLC_TOKEN.description: PAT/App token — needed when GITHUB_TOKEN lacks cross-repo issue access
